GOAL: produce a curated CUMCM2026 B-problem support-materials ZIP at

HARD BUDGET: the final .zip file size MUST be <= 20,000,000 bytes. Target 10-18 MB. A previous attempt produced 473.89 MB staged / 65.67 MB zip and was REJECTED. You must measure the real byte size with `(Get-Item $zip).Length` and report it.

WHY THE PREVIOUS ATTEMPT FAILED (root cause - do not repeat it):
The exclusion filter was applied as a regex `-match '\\results\\|\\output\\'` over full paths. That pattern matches `\results\` and `\output\` but NOT `\paper_evidence\`, `\runs\`, or `\verification\`, so 393 MB of `paper_evidence`, 17 MB of `runs`, and 12.5 MB of `verification` were copied into the staging tree. Rebuild the staging tree from scratch. Do NOT trust a path-regex filter: enumerate candidate files with `Get-ChildItem`, then filter with explicit conditions, and PRINT a per-top-level-directory size table of the staging tree BEFORE zipping so the budget is provable.

SOURCE LAYOUT FACTS (verify each yourself; do not assume):
- Workspace root: `D:\CUMCM2026`
- `src\q1\` - code in `src\q1\code\`, model doc `src\q1\q1.md`
- `src\q2\` - code in `src\q2\code\`; also `src\q2\formal\`, `src\q2\tests_formal\`; model docs are the `*.md` directly in `src\q2\`
- `src\q3+4\` - V1 engine: `code\`, `docs\`, `figures\`, `tools\`  (its `code\results\` = 572 MB and `code\output\` = 72 MB must be EXCLUDED)
- `src\q3+q4_v2\` - V2 engine (the delivered strategy). EXCLUDE its `paper_evidence\` (393 MB), `runs\` (17 MB), and `verification\` (12.5 MB) subtrees; everything else IS included (~12.8 MB).
- `simu\数据\` - holds 7 `*.jlog` simulator logs (~700 KB total)

```

MANIFEST.csv                  <- you generate: relative_path,bytes,sha256

  q2/artifacts/               <- ONLY loose files directly in src\q2\code\artifacts\ smaller than 100000 bytes
  q3_q4_v1/                   <- src\q3+4\code\ (minus results/, output/), docs/, figures/, tools/
  q3_q4_v2/                   <- src\q3+q4_v2\ (minus paper_evidence/, runs/, verification/)
02_documentation/
  q3_q4_v2/docs/              <- src\q3+q4_v2\docs\*.md + *.json
  q3_q4_v1/docs/              <- src\q3+4\docs\*.md + *.json
  q2_reports/                 <- src\q2\code\reports\*.md
03_paper_evidence/            <- from src\q3+q4_v2\paper_evidence\
  figures/                    <- figures\*.jpg + figures\*.json
  figure_data/                <- figure_data\*.csv
  tables/                     <- tables\*.csv
  flowcharts/                 <- flowcharts\* (skip any single file > 200000 bytes)
  claims.json claims.md figure_contract.md final_preflight.md figures_manifest.json
  flowcharts_manifest.json variant_registry.json Q3_Q4_Paper_Replacement_Final.md
  docx_update_report.json paired_run_status.json source_manifest.json
04_raw_run_evidence/
  per_run/v1_frozen/q3/       <- for EVERY run dir under paper_evidence\runs\v1_frozen\q3\,
  per_run/v1_frozen/q4/          copy metrics.json, run_report.json, verifier_report.json
  per_run/v2_final/q3/           flattened as "<rundir>__<filename>" (e.g. paper_q3_n13_s950021__metrics.json)
  per_run/v2_final/q4/        <- same for runs\v2_final\q3 and q4
  sample_runs/v1_frozen/q3/paper_q3_n13_s950021/
  sample_runs/v1_frozen/q4/paper_q4_n10_s960000/
  sample_runs/v2_final/q3/paper_q3_n13_s950020/
  sample_runs/v2_final/q4/paper_q4_n10_s960000/
      <- for each of those 4 dirs copy whichever exist: metrics.json, run_report.json,
         verifier_report.json, policy_config.json, config.yaml, provenance.json,
         paper_command.json, ground_truth.json, certificate.json, trajectory.csv
         (SKIP any single file larger than 5,000,000 bytes)
05_simulator_logs/            <- rename on copy to drop practice IDs:
      simu\数据\formal-p3-1-VUXH-728S-5QND-4JGQ.jlog  ->  formal-p3-1.jlog
      simu\数据\formal-p4-1-PFZQ-G9BM-KDEX-ZQN9.jlog  ->  formal-p4-1.jlog
```

ALWAYS EXCLUDE these path components anywhere in the tree:
`__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `.ipynb_checkpoints`, `_legacy_superseded_v6`, `results`, `output`, `paper_evidence`, `runs`, `verification`

After staging, replace the literal string `TEAM001` with `TEAMXXX` in every staged TEXT file

MANIFEST.csv: write it at the staging root (so it lands at the zip root) with header
`relative_path,bytes,sha256`, listing every other staged file with a forward-slash relative path
and its SHA-256. Also save a copy to `D:\CUMCM2026\agentworkspace\work\package_manifest.csv`.

BUILD SCRIPT: write your build script to `D:\CUMCM2026\agentworkspace\work\package_support.ps1` (an earlier broken version is there - overwrite it). Run it with `pwsh -NoProfile -File`. Make the script idempotent: it must delete and recreate the staging dir each run.

Also report the per-question file counts so the verifier can check them.
